name: Katagiri Yuuhi
source:
Yuuhi is the main heroine. She is very beautiful, which often causes trouble for her, such as being harassed constantly by men. One day, when she was being harassed by two men, she was saved by Jun'ichi. She transferred to his school hoping meet her fiance because she heard that he was in this area. 

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akane_Iro_ni_Somaru_Saka]Wikipedia[/url].]
